tasks.build: npm run build && deno task licenses
tasks.duplicates:sarif: npm exec -- jscpd src --reporters sarif --output reports/jscpd
tasks.check: deno check src/main.ts && npm run check
tasks.verify: deno task lint && deno task quality && deno task quality:magic-numbers && deno task duplicates:ratchet && deno fmt --check src scripts tests vitest .storybook stories deno.json biome.json biome.legacy.json .jscpd.json stryker.config.mjs vite.config.ts && deno task check && deno task test && deno task test:svelte && npm run build
tasks.coverage:deno: deno test -A --coverage=reports/coverage/deno src tests scripts && deno coverage --lcov --output=reports/coverage/deno.lcov reports/coverage/deno
tasks.desktop:probe: deno task desktop:preflight && deno task desktop:probe:build && deno task desktop:probe:run
tasks.desktop: deno task desktop:preflight && deno task build && deno task desktop:build && deno task desktop:run
tasks.desktop:surreal: deno task desktop:preflight && deno task build && deno task desktop:build && deno task desktop:run:surreal
tasks.desktop:json: deno task desktop:preflight && deno task build && deno task desktop:build && deno task desktop:run:json
tasks.desktop:msix: deno task licenses && deno run -A scripts/desktop_msix.ts
